# Test navigation built from a Mintlify docs.json

# The server runs inside docs/, while docs.json sits at the site root and
# names pages relative to it.
cd docs

md2html -http :8096 -base /docs -nav &
wait-port :8096

curl -s http://localhost:8096/docs/quickstart

# Groups appear in docs.json order with their pages beneath them
stdout 'Start here'
stdout 'Reference'
stdout 'href="[^"]*index"[^>]*>\s*Home'
stdout 'href="[^"]*commands"'

# Page titles come from frontmatter, falling back to the first heading
stdout '>\s*Quickstart\s*<'

# The site name from docs.json titles the site
stdout '<title>Quickstart</title>'
stdout 'example docs'

# Prev/next follow docs.json order, not the file system
stdout 'Home'

-- docs.json --
{
  "name": "example docs",
  "navigation": {
    "groups": [
      {
        "group": "Start here",
        "pages": ["docs/index", "docs/quickstart"]
      },
      {
        "group": "Reference",
        "pages": ["docs/commands"]
      }
    ]
  }
}

-- docs/index.md --
---
title: Home
---

# Welcome

-- docs/quickstart.md --
# Quickstart

Install it.

-- docs/commands.md --
# Command reference
